_how_to_use: 406 JPEGs carved from a 119-page PDF of GCR trade reviews.
The PDF has almost no text layer (137 chars), so the content IS the images.
Tweet screenshots here are NOT all present in gcr_archive.txt - spot-checked
'fade listing pumps' (IOTX/TRU/CLV/MNGO/AXS) appears only in the images.
Review is incremental: set reviewed=true and fill notes as images are read.
'kind' is aspect-ratio guesswork; 'content' on a reviewed image is the truth (img001 is a header painting the ratio called a tweet).

images.notes: NOT a tweet — a Twitter header painting (1500x500 is the 3:1 header ratio). No trading content. Shows the aspect-ratio classifier cannot separate headers from tweet screenshots; treat 'tweet_screenshot' as a hint, not a fact.

Annotated BTC chart, 2021: called a top on unsustainable OI and funding with spot buyers exhausted (tweeted @ 51,193), then bought the ~20% flush at 45,000. Reaction-to-positioning, not chart pattern.

Binance USDT-perp blotter, ~Jan 2022 (BTC entry 38,831 / mark 33,505). NINE positions, EIGHT short: BTC -149.861 (5x), ETC -12,000, DOGE -19,401,834, RLC -280,000, EGLD -4,800, AVAX -57,000, GRT -1,200,000, 1000SHIB -174,489,342; the lone long is 58 SUSHI (~$1k, noise beside millions). Cross margin, 1x-5x. Two things follow: (1) a one-sided short book is normal for him, which is why check_hedged_book was replaced; (2) he shorts small and mid caps (RLC, GRT, EGLD, ETC), confirming 'never short small caps' is not literal. Note 1000SHIB — the target shorts kSHIB, the same instrument family.

Twitter @GiganticRebirth, Sep 8. Shorting dYdX into the airdrop unlock: 'what happens to the price of dydx when everyone claims their free tokens and TPs', then 'going to close here for pennies... don't love the rr of holding this open too long'. Same family as fading listing pumps: he shorts SUPPLY events (listings, airdrop unlocks) and exits fast. Suggests a testable trait — short-dated shorts around new listings — not yet implemented.

DISCORD, not Twitter — the corpus includes private-group posts absent from the tweet archive. Late 2021, on psychology: letting go of 'peak net worth', protecting capital, 'easy mode is over', 2022 will be more hostile terrain. Character, not a testable trait.
